may-app-answer-status-directly.rationale: May answers bounded informational requests directly when current evidence is already available.

may-app-clarify-ambiguous-target.rationale: May asks one focused question when two accountable Apps imply materially different outcomes.

may-app-delegate-one-shot-outcome.rationale: Durable domain work is delegated once to its accountable App with outcome, constraints, and proof.

may-app-delegate-recurring-outcome.rationale: May preserves requested cadence as intent while the domain App chooses task and schedule mechanics.

may-app-route-ownership-gap.rationale: An unknown ownership gap goes to may-agent rather than becoming a hidden May task.

may-app-review-terminal-result.rationale: May closes the conversation only after reviewing the exact terminal child result.

may-app-replan-missing-proof.rationale: A claimed fix without required proof is returned to the accountable App instead of reported complete.

may-app-stop-standing-outcome.rationale: May routes a stop outcome to the owning App without editing its task or schedule.
